ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_softplus_advantage_weighted_loss
ir.intuition: Repaired by changing the loss link from log-sigmoid to softplus to reduce similarity with existing works and improve numerical stability. Softplus of negative margin acts as a smooth hinge-like loss encouraging margin > 0. Kept margin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l - beta * advantage_gap and clamped margin to [-10, 10] to prevent extreme values causing instability. Multiplying by optional weight preserves weighted samples. This loss differs structurally from previous sigmoid-based ones, avoiding direct log-sigmoid usage and thus increasing novelty while remaining stable and effective.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl - beta * advantage_gap
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
losses = softplus(-clamped_margin)
if weight is not None:
    losses = weight * losses
loss = mean(losses)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('clip_val', 10.0)))
    margin = ops.sub(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.mul(beta, adv))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
    losses = ops.softplus(ops.neg(clamped_margin))
    if weight is not None:
        losses = ops.mul(losses, weight)
    return ops.mean(losses)
